description_en: Retrieves a custom monitoring alert rule
description_zh: 获取自定义监控告警规则
name: GetAlertRule

parameters.help_en: The ID of the custom alert rule
parameters.name: id

AlertRule.description_en: The details of the custom alert rule

Enabled.description_en: Indicates whether the alert rule is enabled

Id.description_en: The ID of the custom alert rule

Name.description_en: The name of the custom alert rule

items.description_en:
The alert channel. Valid values:

Mail: email.
Phone: phone call.
Sms: text message.
Dingding: DingTalk webhook.
Feishu: Lark webhook.
Weixin: WeCom webhook.
Webhook: custom webhook
items.description_zh:
告警通道，枚举值：
Mail: 邮件
Phone: 电话
Sms: 短信
Dingding: 钉钉webhook
Feishu: 飞书webhook
Weixin: 企业微信webhook
Webhook: 自定义Webhook

IntervalInMinutes.description_en: The alert interval, in minutes. Valid values: 5 to 10000
IntervalInMinutes.description_zh: 告警间隔，单位为分钟，取值范围[5,10000]

Maximum.description_en: The maximum number of alerts within a calendar day. Valid values: 1 to 10000
Maximum.description_zh: 一个自然日内的告警最大次数，取值范围[1, 10000]

Extension.description_en: The additional configuration required by the alert recipient. If ReceiverType is DingdingUrl, you can set {"atAll":true} to @ all members
Extension.description_zh: 告警对象需要的额外配置，当 ReceiverType 为 DingdingUrl，支持设置 {"atAll":true}  @所有人

ReceiverType.description_en:
The type of the alert recipient. Valid values:

AliUid: Alibaba Cloud UID.
ShiftSchedule: shift schedule.
TaskOwner: node owner. Applicable to custom alerting and event alerting.
Owner: owner. Applicable to baseline alerting.
WebhookUrl: custom webhook URL.
DingdingUrl: DingTalk webhook URL.
FeishuUrl: Lark webhook URL.
WeixinUrl: WeChat webhook URL
ReceiverType.description_zh:
告警接收对象类型，枚举值：
AliUid: 阿里云UID
ShiftSchedule: 值班表
TaskOwner: 任务责任人，适用于自定义告警和事件告警
Owner: 责任人，适用于基线告警
WebhookUrl: 自定义webhookUrl
DingdingUrl: 钉钉webhookUrl
FeishuUrl: 飞书webhookUrl
WeixinUrl: 企业微信webhookUrl

ReceiverValues.description_en: The values of the alert recipient

items.description_en: The value of the alert recipient. If ReceiverType is AliUid, specify an Alibaba Cloud UID. If ReceiverType is ShiftSchedule, specify a shift schedule ID. If ReceiverType is WebhookUrl, DingdingUrl, FeishuUrl, or WeixinUrl, specify the corresponding URL
items.description_zh: 告警接收对象值。当 ReceiverType 为 AliUid 时填阿里云UID，为 ShiftSchedule 时填值班表ID，为 WebhookUrl / DingdingUrl / FeishuUrl / WeixinUrl 时填入对应的 URL

SilenceEndTime.description_en: The end time of the mute period. Format: HH:mm:ss
SilenceEndTime.description_zh: 静默结束时间，格式为 HH:mm:ss

SilenceStartTime.description_en: The start time of the mute period. Format: HH:mm:ss
SilenceStartTime.description_zh: 静默开始时间，格式为 HH:mm:ss

Owner.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud UID of the owner of the custom alert rule
Owner.description_zh: 自定义规则的责任人阿里云UID

TriggerCondition.description_en: The condition that triggers the alert

Extension.description_en: The extension information. Required for certain trigger conditions
Extension.description_zh: 扩展信息，部分触发条件需要配置

CycleAndTime.description_en: The list of cycle and time configurations

CycleId.description_en: The cycle ID. Valid values: 1 to 288

Time.description_en: The timeout time. Format: hh:mm. Valid values of hh: 0 to 47. Valid values of mm: 0 to 59
Time.description_zh: 超时时间，格式为 hh:mm，hh的取值范围为[0,47]，mm的取值范围为[0,59]

AutoRerunAlertEnabled.description_en: Specifies whether to generate an alert when a batch task is automatically rerun due to a failure
AutoRerunAlertEnabled.description_zh: 离线任务由于失败自动重跑，是否产生告警

StreamTaskIds.description_en: The IDs of real-time computing nodes to monitor
StreamTaskIds.description_zh: 监控实时计算任务时，填入对应的任务ID

items.description_en: The ID of the real-time computing node

InstanceErrorCount.description_en: The instance error count alert configuration
InstanceErrorCount.description_zh: 实例出错数量告警配置

Count.description_en: The number of failed instances. Valid values: 1 to 10000
Count.description_zh: 出错的实例数，取值范围为[1,10000]

InstanceErrorPercentage.description_en: The instance error percentage alert configuration
InstanceErrorPercentage.description_zh: 实例出错比例告警配置

Percentage.description_en: The percentage of failed instances. Valid values: 1 to 100
Percentage.description_zh: 出错实例占比，取值范围 [1-100]

InstanceTransferFluctuate.description_en: The instance count fluctuation alert configuration
InstanceTransferFluctuate.description_zh: 转实例数量波动告警配置

Percentage.description_en: The fluctuation percentage. Valid values: 1 to 100
Percentage.description_zh: 转实例波动百分比，取值范围[1-100]

Trend.description_en:
The fluctuation type. Valid values:

abs: absolute value.
increase: increase.
decrease: decrease
Trend.description_zh:
转实例波动类型，枚举值：
abs: 绝对值
increase: 增长
decrease: 下降

UnFinishedTime.description_en: The not-completed time. Format: hh:mm. Valid values of hh: 0 to 47. Valid values of mm: 0 to 59
UnFinishedTime.description_zh: 未完成时间，格式为 hh:mm，hh的取值范围为[0,47]，mm的取值范围为[0,59]

items.description_en: The ID of the whitelisted monitored node

Ids.description_en: The list of monitored object IDs

items.description_en: The ID of the monitored object

Type.description_en:
The monitored object type. Valid values:

Task: node.
Baseline: baseline.
Project: workspace.
BizProcess: business process flow
Type.description_zh:
监控对象类型，枚举值：
Task: 任务节点
Baseline: 基线
Project: 工作空间
BizProcess - 业务流程

Type.description_en:
The type of the alert trigger. Valid values:

Finished: instance completed.
UnFinished: instance not completed.
Error: instance failed.
CycleUnfinished: instance cycle not completed.
Timeout: instance timed out.
InstanceTransferComplete: node-to-instance conversion completed.
InstanceTransferFluctuate: instance count fluctuation.
ExhaustedError: instance still failed after automatic reruns.
InstanceKeyword: failed instance contains keyword.
InstanceErrorCount: number of failed instances.
InstanceErrorPercentage: percentage of failed instances.
ResourceGroupPercentage: schedule resource utilization.
ResourceGroupWaitCount: number of instances waiting for schedule resources
Type.description_zh:
触发报警的类型，枚举值：
Finished: 实例完成
UnFinished: 实例未完成
Error: 实例出错
CycleUnfinished: 实例周期未完成
Timeout: 实例超时
InstanceTransferComplete: 任务转实例完成
InstanceTransferFluctuate: 实例数量波动
ExhaustedError: 自动重跑后仍出错
InstanceKeyword: 出错实例包含关键词
InstanceErrorCount: 出错实例数量
InstanceErrorPercentage: 出错实例占比 
ResourceGroupPercentage: 资源组利用率
ResourceGroupWaitCount: 资源组等资源实例数

RequestId.description_en: The request ID, which is used to locate logs and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 请求的 ID，用于定位日志、排查问题
